_comment: Emberreach milestones. Rewards are deliberately modest (small GP, XP, or useful item supplies) and are collected by claiming them on the Milestones screen, so achievements never become mandatory grinding. Condition kinds: skill_level, total_level, item_count, lifetime_item, monsters_killed, dungeons_cleared, items_discovered, gp_earned, actions_completed, quests_completed, pets_unlocked, settlement_buildings. Evaluation is a pure function of persisted state, so a milestone earned offline or before it was added still counts.
